name: What causes a kitchen sink drain to clog?

mainEntity.name: What causes a kitchen sink drain to clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen sink drains commonly clog due to a buildup of grease, food particles, and soap scum. Over time, these materials accumulate on the interior walls of the pipes, restricting water flow until a complete blockage occurs. Regular disposal of grease in the trash rather than down the drain, and using a drain screen, can significantly reduce the frequency of these clogs. CG Plumbing Solutions addresses these common issues to restore proper drainage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen sink clogs are typically caused by accumulated grease, food particles, and soap scum. Preventative measures like proper grease disposal and drain screens can help.
